name: Playgama Bridge
description: Publishes a web game on the platforms of Playgama Bridge with one API: the platform and the player, interstitial, rewarded and banner ads, the storage of the platform and the messages of the game.

bridgeUrl.description: The address of the script of Playgama Bridge, by default the file of its npm release 2.4.1, which a site may also serve next to its page.
